title: U.S. and NATO commander vows to thwart Moscow, warns Kyiv over refinery strikes - The Washington Post
description: The mixed signals expose a split in President Donald Trump’s approach to Russia, amid strain on energy markets.

title: RJ Mitte, actor best known for playing Walter White Jr. on ‘Breaking Bad,’ dies at 34 - NBC News
description: Actor RJ Mitte, known for playing the son of Walter White in the hit AMC series “Breaking Bad” and as an advocate for the rights of those with disabilities, has died at the age of 34, his representatives said Monday.

title: Actress Selma Blair arrested after allegedly biting flight attendant, being restrained on flight from LAX to JFK, source says - CBS News
description: Actress Selma Blair has been arrested after an incident on board a Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles to John F. Kennedy International Airport Sunday night.

title: Trump says he's "looking at" firing Kimberly Guilfoyle: "We're not happy" - CBS News
description: "Well, we're looking at it," President Trump said when asked if he's considering firing U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle.

title: California beaches, homes slammed by waves from Tropical Storm Rachel - The Washington Post
description: Some houses were marked as unsafe after the ground washed away beneath them.
